exceptions.rationale: Stack exhaustion through deeply nested brace patterns. braces is installed only through the lint toolchain (eslint-config-next and typescript-eslint, via fast-glob and micromatch) and never runs in the deployed application; the only patterns it receives come from the repository configuration. No fixed version is published. Accepted by the owner on 2026-10-03 for 30 days; update as soon as a fix exists.
evidence: bun audit: eslint-config-next > @next/eslint-plugin-next > fast-glob > micromatch > braces
npm registry: 3.0.3 is the latest published version of braces

Re-reviewed 2026-10-08 after next 16.3.8, sharp 0.35.5, smol-toml 1.9.0 and source-map-js 1.2.2: bun audit shows the same two lint-toolchain paths to braces, and braces 3.0.3 is still the latest published version.
